Subject: Acme exec workshop — consolidated notes & action tracker

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for hosting the Redwood team onsite yesterday. We left with a clear set of priorities and a good sense of next steps across architecture, procurement, and executive alignment. Per our quick review, I attached a cleaned slide deck and an action-items template to make tracking simpler.

Attachments (in this message):
- redwood-onsite-deck-v2.pdf (slides presented at the executive session)
- action_items_template.csv (CSV with columns: owner, task, description, priority, due_date, status)

What I captured as immediate asks (please confirm or update):
1) Integration PoC scope — Dev Patel to own; target: internal demo by 2026-03-26
2) Procurement checklist — Rishi to start contract/terms dialogue and loop Legal on the noted items (SLA, data retention) — target: draft for Acme review by 2026-03-19
3) Exec summary slide for Acme leadership — Vivek to draft and share by 2026-03-12

Action I need from you: please confirm the attendee list and any additional items you want added to the tracker. Once you confirm, we will:
- Publish a single action-tracker (Google Sheet) and give edit access to named owners
- Upload final meeting notes and the slide deck to a shared Drive folder
- Share the exec summary and a one-page rollout plan for your leadership team

If it helps, I can publish the notes and tracker and then share edit permissions to your four confirmed participants.

Next touchpoint suggestion: 30-min sync the week of 2026-03-15 to review the first set of actions.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
